title: mustBeVector
summary: Validate that a value is vector-shaped.

gpu_support.notes: Validators run on host values and metadata; they throw on validation failure.

tested.integration: Representative callable and arguments-block coverage in crates/runmat-vm/tests/functions.rs; not every validator has a dedicated VM case.

description: `mustBeVector` is available as a callable MATLAB argument validator. It returns no user-facing value when validation passes and throws a structured RunMat error when validation fails. Validators with literal/static payloads are also encoded in MATLAB `arguments` blocks; dynamic validator payload expressions should call the validator directly until runtime-evaluated arguments-block payloads are implemented.
behaviors: Callable validator forms enforce exact supported arity, throw on validation failure, and suppress automatic output on success.
The ordinary form accepts 1-by-N or N-by-1 arrays, including 0-by-1 and 1-by-0 integer vectors, and rejects multidimensional or other empty shapes from metadata without payload access.
The documented 'allow-all-empties' form additionally accepts every empty shape and is supported consistently by callable validation and MATLAB arguments blocks.
Arguments-block validation uses the same shared runtime predicates for validators that RunMat can encode statically.
Numeric validators check every element without materializing a cloned numeric array, including sparse stored values and implicit sparse zeros where relevant.
Text validators accept string scalars/arrays, character row vectors, and compatible cell arrays of text where MATLAB commonly permits them.

examples.description: Using the validator as a normal callable guard
examples.output: No output when validation passes; an error is thrown when validation fails.
No output when A is vector-shaped or empty; an error is thrown otherwise.

faqs.question: Does this validator work in an `arguments` block?
faqs.answer: Yes for literal/static validator payloads that RunMat can encode at compile time. Dynamic validator payload expressions should use the callable form for now.
